title: Review — M-MAP + M-BUS (the visible slice)
desc:
When M-MAP and M-BUS are delivered:
(1) MAP — boot the page headless against a fixture world (the vigil smoke pattern); verify the phantom check fails on a fabricated avatar (inject one, watch the build fail, remove it); every click opens its source record; freshness amber past 45 min; phone-width sanity.
(2) BUS — reproduce the typed exchange on the real bus; try to close a dependent task WITHOUT the required response (must be refused); then with it (must close); check the thread mirror carries the bus id.
THEN cast NON-OWNER ballots (accept-inspected / deny-inspected) on M-MAP and M-BUS with findings. A CHARTER section 3 violation (anything simulated on the map) is an automatic deny.
